compiled_state.title: [Inbound Bridge]: New Jira issues not mirrored to local tracker -> 49 of 50 most-recent DIG issues missing local jira-dig-* mirror
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 0c26228c77e3322b10a488eb32ef037ca16a127c

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per the inbound bridge contract (plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/README.md), every Jira issue created in the DIG project should produce a CREATE event in the local tracker, materializing as a jira-dig-* ticket.

#### Actual Behavior

Audit on 2026-05-12: queried the 50 most-recently-updated DIG Jira issues; 49 of them have no corresponding local jira-dig-* mirror.

Local jira-dig IDs cap at 1682 with a single outlier at 2167. New Jira issues DIG-2484, DIG-2485, ..., DIG-2493 (created in the last 24-48h) are absent locally.

Inbound bridge GitHub Actions workflow runs return exit code 0 (success) but produce no CREATE events in the tickets branch.

### 3. Action History

Cited workflow runs (gh workflow inbound-bridge.yml):
- run 25770963896 — clean of CREATE events
- run 25747533218 — clean of CREATE events
- run 25700898892 — clean of CREATE events

### 6. Logs

Reproduction:
```
# Query Jira:
project=DIG ORDER BY updated DESC, last 14d

# Cross-check local tracker:
.claude/scripts/dso ticket list | jq '[.[] | select(.id|startswith("jira-dig-"))]'
```
Expected: each recent Jira issue has a local mirror. Actual: 49/50 missing.

comments.body: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (ADVANCED code-tracer): handle_type_check (_handle_type.py:53) returns True for every issue when type_mapping={} because mapping.get(any_type) always returns None on an empty dict. The filter at bridge-inbound.py:447-451 then produces empty creatable_issues, so write_create_events writes nothing. Fix: add 'if not type_mapping: return False' after the empty-jira_type check in _handle_type.py. Historical: jira-dig-1..1682 were created pre-2026-04-12 (no type gate) or while INBOUND_TYPE_MAPPING var was set. Repo var cleared ~2026-05-02, fallback {} engaged. Side effect: orphan BRIDGE_ALERT-only dirs created per filtered issue.
